comments.author: Kevin
comments.body: Phoenix is based on Mozilla which is a Carbon front end with a Unix back end. The build instructions are here. You have to pull the source and build Mozilla regularly. Then update your .mozconfig file with as in this page (without the last xft line). That'll build Phoenix. But the phoenix-bin will be corrupt somehow. You can use the phoenix-bin from my build or use a mozilla-bin file and rename it to phoenix-bin.

comments.author: Ben
comments.body:
Could it have to do with the optimization line (second to last)?

i686 typically has to do with optimization for Pentium 2, 3, or 4 (I'm not sure where the boundry between i586 and i686 is). Optimizing something for a PC won't help it to run on a Mac.

comments.author: Kevin
comments.body:
Ah, well I didn't use the i686 line either. This is the .mozconfig I used.

 export MOZ_PHOENIX=1

ac_add_options --disable-tests
